description: City of Chicago current active business licenses: searches by legal or trade name and returns license type, business activity, address, ward, and license dates. Public open data (Socrata); licence rows only, no ownership or credit data. Takes 1 to 10 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_nyc_business_licenses when you need NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection license; b2b_ny_business_entity when you need New York Department of State active corporations: searches. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
